name: quality
description: Level 6: quality. Lower level numbers win.

rules.rationale: Under this a page is usually a stub, a 404 or a cookie wall.
Visible text divided by raw bytes. Below this the page is markup and navigation, not content.
A page that is mostly links is an index page. It belongs in the frontier, not in the corpus.
Navigation, cookie banners and footers appear on every page and would dominate the token counts.
